notice: Minimal original evidence input authored for AUT 250 Week 3. It supplies an illustrative flash-code observation and a written retrieval procedure. It contains NO manufacturer code table, NO reproduced glossary, NO OEM definition and NO service specification. Code meaning is intentionally unresolved.
codeMeaningNotice: This lab does not assert what the observation means. Establishing meaning requires a verified manufacturer source together with the full retrieval context. That source is not available to this project.

observation.capturedConditions: warm ambient, no load applied, self-test connector engaged

retrievalProcedure: Confirm the vehicle profile and record make, model year, engine and retrieval method before starting.
Confirm the test mode and record it alongside the observation.
Record the raw output exactly as presented, without adding a meaning.
Mark the meaning as requiring a verified source if none is available.
Re-test under the same conditions before drawing any conclusion about persistence.
whatThisEvidenceDoesNotEstablish: It does not identify which component caused the stored condition.
It does not establish that any component has failed.
It does not establish the numeric code's meaning for this manufacturer or test mode.
It does not establish whether the condition is currently present.
